purpose: Add in-domain relation-sensitive ranking supervision to expanded-v4 without changing any gold label.

source.examples: Only the leading 34,919 fit rows of frozen expanded-v4 examples.jsonl.
source.answers: Only the leading 3,680 fit rows of frozen expanded-v4 answers.jsonl.

pair_definition.same_context: Both endpoints have the exact same source_id, question and three underlying passage hashes, and different generated responses.
pair_definition.opposite_labels: Positive endpoint has frozen v4 gold_label=1; negative endpoint has frozen v4 gold_label=0.
pair_definition.surface: Deterministic token/character similarity >= 0.52; object-only contrasts require >= 0.72.
pair_definition.relation: Require matched subject/predicate anchors or a strong ordered lexical skeleton plus a differing quantity, negation, temporal, source-reference or object slot.
pair_definition.gold_alignment: For partial positives, a positive-side changed term must overlap the unchanged risk-BPE terms; no new factual judgment is made.
pair_definition.ambiguity_filters: Exclude same-response pairs, normalized exact text with opposite projected labels, low-content scaffolds, pairs without explicit slot contrast, anchor mismatch and partial-label scope mismatch.

crossfit: Each pair inherits its single source-connected held_fold. OOF model f may train only on pairs whose held_fold != f; full-fit uses all pairs.

proposed_loss.base: Unchanged expanded-v4 weighted BCE over all training microclaims.
proposed_loss.ranking: Weighted RankNet softplus(risk_negative - risk_positive), with equal source-group mass then equal pair mass; weights are recomputed inside each OOF training split.
proposed_loss.endpoint_inputs: Reuse each endpoint's unchanged expanded-v4 top-2 cross-encoder input.

evaluation: Unchanged v4 fit-OOF thresholding and calibration evaluation; this artifact performs no training or scoring.
